description: The DevicErts record of one device: names as registered, manufacturer, headline status, risk class with its legal system, and every authorization, registration and listing with number, dates and status. detail=full adds identifiers (UDI-DI, Basic UDI-DI, catalogue and submission numbers), FDA product codes, EMDN and GMDN codes, EU notified-body certificates, FDA recalls, EU market availability and the registry properties. Renamed or merged pages resolve to the current slug.

detail.description: summary (default): names, manufacturer, status, class, authorizations. full: adds identifiers, nomenclature codes, EU certificates, recalls, EU market availability and registry properties.

slug.description: The device slug, the last part of its https://devicerts.com/devices/<slug> URL (a full page URL is accepted too).

name: get_device
title: Get a device record
